next_n and next_delta_i are acquisition outputs, not team optima.
No payloads were supplied. run_design places the default 25.0 Å heuristic radius on each end repeat. That radius is not a measured OtsA/OtsB size.

warnings: Rise, twist, and radius are a screw fit to deposited C-alpha coordinates from PDB 2AVP, 2HYZ, and 2FO7. DOI 10.1107/S0907444907024353. The article PDF was not open, so no sentence was copied from it.
The asymmetric unit holds 2 or 4 repeats, not a full eight-repeat superhelix. The step is the transform between consecutive 34-residue blocks in that chain.
Sample standard deviations divide by n-1. They are the scatter of 7 steps, not a standard error printed in the paper.

No persistence length is in this coordinate table. The open abstract of Synakewicz et al. 2022, ACS Nano, DOI 10.1021/acsnano.1c09162, also does not state one. The 15 nm cutoff stays a project cutoff.
The runtime scaffold radius is the mean repeat-centroid radius. Payload clash uses the placed C-alpha trace, not a cylinder of this radius.

The runtime docking radius is the mean radial distance of the inter-repeat junction: the midpoint of C-alpha 34 and C-alpha 1 of the next 34-residue block. In these entries that junction follows DPRS. The previous 0.35 nm loop offset is not used.
All structural/kinetic numbers are literature placeholders, not this project's lab data.
Recruitment Kd is default_cam_m13_pair() from origami.priors.CAM_M13_KD_M (1.9e-10 M), prior id cam_m13_peptide_0.19nM. kon is absent on that pair and is not invented.
c_free_M was not supplied. Recruitment was evaluated with the signal gate off. No physiological free concentration was assumed.
No time course: association is off.

Stability prior is Phillips et al. 2012, DOI 10.1002/pro.2018, Table I, DSC, CTPRa only. Comparison temperature is 37.0 C, the chosen E. coli operating point, not a temperature from that table. calibrated is false.
delta_i is the repeat separation of two payloads on this scaffold. It is not the total repeat count n.
The residual GP was not fit. Its posterior mean equals the physics score and its variance is flat. Repeat-count observations were not used.
next_delta_i is that untrained acquisition. It is not a team length and it is not trained toward 14.

Effective concentration comes from physics_report. Each payload stands off by one (GGGGS)3 RMS, and the pair width is the hypotenuse of two of those widths. A payload linker_sigma_A on the design is not substituted. The residual GP stays unfitted: the retrieved literature has geometry and linker mechanics, not an assay y for this score.
A separation that is a multiple of 8 repeats puts the docking sites on the same face again. Pair clash can rise there.
Untrained acquisition selected delta_i=7. calibrated is false.
delta_G is the unfolding free energy from the same Table I as the Tm series (10.1002/pro.2018, Table I, kcal mol-1). The sign is as printed. It is not the pass/fail rule.

Among repeat counts that pass the steric gate and the Tm gate, the largest printed unfolding ΔG in Table I (10.1002/pro.2018, kcal mol-1) is at n=10. The comparison uses the sign printed in that table. It does not change next_n and it is not a second model.

deposited.method: C-alpha coordinates of the asymmetric-unit polymer chain. Residues are consecutive blocks of 34, the period at which that chain sequence is identical. Each block is rigidly fit onto the next by Kabsch, then decomposed into a screw. Coordinates are rounded to 0.001 angstrom. The Kajander 2007 article PDF is not open access; these are the deposited coordinates cited by that article, not a sentence copied from the PDF.

notes: n=2 and n=20 are the team bounds. They are not optima.
n=3 is the biomarker measurement length, chosen next to the lower bound.

n=14 is the team channeling candidate. shortest_end_pair_n is the first scanned length whose end-pair clash probability is below the same limit recommend() uses. Those two numbers are equal only when the scan says so.
active_learner_next_n is the untrained acquisition on this scan. No observation was added to force a repeat count.
n=14 is not a measured row in the default Phillips CTPRa DSC series. The thermal gate marks it extrapolated, so the acquisition does not rank it while that prior is on.
n=20 is the team upper bound. It is not a measured melting temperature in the default series, and it is not a solubility limit.
delta_i is the repeat separation of two payloads on this scaffold. It is not the total repeat count n.

Each row is structural_report plus the thermal gate plus physics_report.
rigid_screw is true when contour length is at most the 15 nm persistence length.
thermal_state pass requires a matched Phillips 2012 CTPRa DSC Tm above t_assay.
n outside that table is extrapolated. No Tm(n) was fit.
